senses.gloss:
थ 1. थ, the second consonant of the
dental class and the aspirate of the preceding letter,
having much the sound of थ् in अन्त्-हिल्ल्, but more
dental.
—थ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound थ्.

2. थ, अस्, m. a mountain; a protector, preserver;
a sign of danger; a kind of disease; eating; (अम्),
n. preserving, preservation; fear, terror; auspicious-
ness; a prayer for the welfare of another.
